Everything above about "Triple Red 7s Multiplier" comes from the Maryland Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
802.headline: A close look at the prizes

803.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "Triple Red 777s", about two-thirds are still unsold. The game is near the midpoint of its run, with three of five top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Triple Red 777s's prize setup is not better or worse than any other. Some games pay many small prizes and some pay a few large ones.

Tomorrow's count on "Triple Red 777s" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.

810.body:
